items.title: # Build Buyer Profile
items.content: Create a detailed customer persona for my product/service: [Product/Service]. Include demographics, goals, pain points, and preferred communication channels. Name the persona.

items.title: # Target Content Creator
items.content: Develop a customer persona for [Content Topic] content. Focus on their information needs, preferred content formats, and where they consume content online. Give them a name and brief backstory.

items.title: # Marketing Strategy Persona
items.content: Generate a customer persona for a marketing campaign targeting [Specific Goal, e.g., 'new software users']. Detail their motivations, objections, and what kind of messaging resonates. Assign a name.

items.title: # Innovate Product User
items.content: Outline a customer persona for a new [Product Type] feature. Describe their current challenges, desired outcomes, and what features would be most valuable to them. Include a name and age range.

items.title: # Marketing Strategy Agent
items.content: Design an AI agent for [small business] to manage [social media marketing]. Detail its role, goals, and core functions for engaging [target audience].

items.title: # Personal Tutor Agent
items.content: Create an AI tutor agent for [subject, e.g., calculus] for [high school students]. Specify its teaching style and how it handles errors.

items.title: # Customer Service Agent
items.content: Outline an AI customer support agent for [e-commerce store]. Describe its personality, escalation path, and knowledge source for FAQs.

items.title: # Research Assistant Agent
items.content: Formulate an AI research assistant for [academic field]. Detail its information gathering strategy, data synthesis, and output format for [reports].

items.title: # Condense Key Information
items.content: Summarize the following text into 5-7 key bullet points, highlighting the most important concepts and definitions: [Paste Text Here]

items.title: # Generate Flashcards Easily
items.content: Create 10 flashcard questions and answers from this text. Format each as Q: [Question] A: [Answer]. Focus on essential facts: [Paste Text Here]

items.title: # Simplify Tough Concepts
items.content: Explain [Complex Topic] in simple terms, as if to a [Target Audience, e.g., high school student], using analogies. Focus on core ideas.

items.title: # Practice Exam Questions
items.content: Generate 5 multiple-choice questions with answers, and 2 short-answer questions based on the following study material: [Paste Study Material Here]

items.title: # Explain Any Skill
items.content: Explain [Skill Name] to me as if I'm a [Target Audience]. Focus on core concepts and practical applications. Provide a simple exercise to get started.

items.title: # Create Learning Plan
items.content: Create a beginner's 5-step learning plan for [Skill Name], including recommended resources and practice tasks for each step. Assume I have no prior experience.

items.title: # Overcome Skill Hurdles
items.content: What are common challenges when learning [Skill Name], and how can I effectively overcome them? Give practical tips and strategies for success.

items.title: # Build Skill Projects
items.content: Suggest a small project I can complete to learn and practice [Skill Name]. Include project steps, required tools, and expected outcomes for a beginner.

items.title: # Explain Code Error
items.content: Explain this error message: [Paste error message here]. What causes it and how can I fix it in [Programming Language]?

items.title: # Refine My Code
items.content: Review this [Programming Language] code for bugs, inefficiencies, and suggest improvements for readability and performance. Code: [Paste code here].

items.title: # Find Logic Flaws
items.content: I'm trying to achieve [Desired outcome] with this [Programming Language] code, but it's not working as expected. Find any logical errors. Code: [Paste code here].

items.title: # Generate Test Cases
items.content: For this [Programming Language] function, generate 3 unit test cases that could help me identify edge cases or bugs. Function: [Paste function here].

items.title: # Explain Code Logic
items.content: Explain the following [programming language] code snippet step-by-step for a [beginner/intermediate] developer. Focus on its purpose and functionality. Code: [Paste Code Here]

items.title: # Generate Code Snippet
items.content: Write a [programming language] function that [describe functionality, e.g., sorts an array of numbers]. Include example usage, comments, and handle common edge cases.

items.title: # Debug My Code
items.content: Identify and fix any bugs in this [programming language] code. Explain the errors clearly and provide the corrected code. Code: [Paste Code Here]

items.title: # Refactor For Clarity
items.content: Refactor the following [programming language] code to improve readability and efficiency, without changing its core functionality. Explain your changes. Code: [Paste Code Here]

items.title: # Structure Your Talk
items.content: Create a detailed presentation outline on [Topic] for a [Audience] that includes an introduction, 3 main points with sub-bullets, and a conclusion. Suggest visuals for each section.

items.title: # Draft Slide Content
items.content: Generate content for 5 slides about [Specific Aspect of Topic]. Each slide should have a title, 3-4 bullet points, and a brief speaker note. Target a [Time] minute segment for [Audience].

items.title: # Prepare Q and A
items.content: Based on a presentation about [Topic] for [Audience], list 5 potential challenging questions and provide concise, expert answers for each. Focus on common concerns or misunderstandings.

items.title: # Boost Audience Engagement
items.content: Suggest a captivating opening hook and a memorable closing statement for a presentation on [Topic] to [Audience]. Include a short anecdote or relatable example for the introduction.
